messages:
eva_sales: FYI we got a formal request from NimbusPay to onboard `cerulean-19b-open` v1.0 and pin it to eu-central only. They need 4-bit quant and strict version pinning (no auto-updates). Asking if we can meet p95 <= 240ms at 15 qps steady.
marta_product: Thanks Eva. Quick checks: do they need Dedicated or is Hosted geo-pin acceptable? Also need to see license and ask for a sample prompt set for staging.
eva_sales: They prefer Hosted with region-only routing to keep costs down. Will attach license + prompts once legal confirms terms.
sam_ml: Note: cerulean-19b has community weights; upstream doesn't publish 4-bit artifacts. We'll need to run quant pipeline and our regression suite. Estimate ~3 infra days if kernels behave. Can start once weights + license are in intake.
lina_infra: For eu-only pinning we need artifact replication to eu region, KMS key for eu logs, and a routing rule that prevents cross-region fallback. Also need to size capacity for 15 qps steady + burst 60 qps. With KV cache and batching we can hit 240ms p95 on 2x A100-80 nodes.
security_bot: Reminder: copy legal to thread and run export-control check before replication to EU (sensitive if training data contains regulated content).
intake_bot: Intake ticket created: INTAKE-9912. Please attach: model tarball, license, sample prompts, billing contact, and MSA link.
marta_product: Proposed acceptance criteria to move into backlog: - license cleared by Legal - staging perf: p95 <= 240ms at 15 qps using their prompts - quantized 4-bit artifact validated (regression pass) - region-only routing + KMS provisioned - version pin (v1.0) enforced and tested - billing & MSA signed
eva_sales: NimbusPay agrees to these criteria and wants a pilot in eu-central within 6 weeks. They're willing to fund a small co-dev for quant if kernels require it.
sam_ml: If co-dev needed, add +4 dev days for kernel/ops tuning. I'll start a quant smoke once we have artifacts in INTAKE-9912 and post results there.
lina_infra: I'll draft region replication checklist and provide infra hours in the intake ticket. If product signs off, we can slot this into the next sprint as customer-driven.
marta_product: I'll take product ownership. Moving to backlog under "customer-onboards/eu-pin" and tagging as customer-driven + needs-legal. Assign infra -> @lina_infra and ml -> @sam_ml before sprint planning.
